mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever noticed how your intuition sometimes nudges you before you even know why? Maybe it’s a quiet unease, a whisper that something’s off, long before your mind can put it into words. Welcome to a journey where we’ll learn to listen to those instincts—where we find out just how powerful our inner warning system can be. Together, we’re about to explore the wisdom inside The Gift of Fear: Survival Signals That Protect Us from Violence, a remarkable book by Gavin de Becker. Through real stories and deep psychological insight, we’ll discover how fear isn’t just something to be avoided—it’s actually one of our greatest allies. We’ll dig into the subtle signals that often come before danger, and talk about why trusting your gut can sometimes make all the difference. Along the way, you’ll learn how to tell the difference between true intuition and anxiety, and get practical tools to help you stay safe—without living in constant fear. So, if you’re ready to turn fear from something that holds you back into a source of strength and resilience, let’s dive in together. Here’s how we can start seeing fear not as a weakness, but as a gift—one that just might protect us, and the people we care about, when it matters most.
